claim: FIR to the commander within 30 calendar days of the out-brief

claim: CAR within 30 calendar days of receiving the FIR covering every FA with findings or ineffective

claim: Waiver to the 36-month requirement goes to IGMC using the Appendix E template

claim: Stand a CGIP at every level you command
quote: Establish a CGIP that inspects all subordinate commands for which you have General Court-Martial Convening Authority (GCMCA) at least every 36 months
fix: State the CGIP requirement attaches to the listed commands (divisions, wings, MLGs, depots, MARFORs, MEFs and similar) for subordinates under GCMCA, not every level of command.

claim: Inspection records retain per DON records schedules
quote: Inspection reports and other records will be retained in accordance with the appropriate DON records schedules

claim: MCO 5210.11F cited as the retention authority in the references list
quote: Refer to reference (f) for Marine Corps records management policy and procedures

claim: CAR within 30 calendar days of receiving the FIR
quote: Within 30 calendar days after receiving the FIR, the inspected commander shall submit a CAR

claim: CAR content: each ineffective FA, finding, reference, recommended solution, corrective action, completion date
quote: Include, at a minimum, each ineffective FA, finding, reference, inspector-provided recommended solution, corrective action, and completion (or projected completion) date

claim: Updated CAR within 15 calendar days of that coordination
quote: coordinate with the inspected command to develop a more appropriate plan and to provide an updated CAR within 15 days
fix: Say 15 days. The order does not say calendar days or name the start event.

claim: IGMC or CIG forwards corrective actions to FA sponsors for suitability review
quote: shall review the submitted CAR and forward the corrective actions to the respective FA sponsors/inspectors to verify that the corrective actions are suitable

claim: Appendix D is the CAR template
quote: The inspected command shall submit the CAR using Appendix D as a template

claim: Subordinate units inspected at least every 36 months
quote: Commanders shall ensure their subordinate units are inspected at least every 36 months

claim: 3-year fiscal year inspection plan coordinated with IGMC
quote: CGIPs shall maintain a 3-year (fiscal year) inspection plan for coordination and deconfliction with IGMC

claim: Deploying units inspected before deployment when scheduling permits
quote: ensure that deploying units are inspected prior to deployment

claim: CIG inspects CoRE, and inspects CoRE Plus and non-CoRE only at the commander direction
quote: CIGs shall inspect all CoRE/CoRE+ FAs and any additional non-CoRE FAs deemed necessary by their commanders ... Where applicable, CoRE+ FAs must be inspected
fix: State the CIG inspects every CoRE and every applicable CoRE+ FA. Only non-CoRE FAs are at the commander discretion.

claim: Recognized waiver grounds are geography, budget and CIG capability gap
quote: In cases where the CIG is unable to inspect a subordinate unit within the 36-month requirement, the command shall submit a waiver request to IGMC
fix: Say the order names inability to inspect within 36 months as the trigger and requires justification in the Appendix E waiver. Geography and budget appear in 5.2.a(5) as grounds to seek authorization for another CIG to inspect.

claim: CIG and TAIGs qualified, trained, cleared and designated in writing
quote: Commanders shall ensure their CIGs and appointed TAIGs are qualified, properly trained, have clearance eligibility ... and are designated in writing to conduct inspections

claim: FIR within 30 calendar days of the out-brief
quote: The IGMC or CIG staff prepares the FIR and submits it to the commander of the inspected unit within 30 calendar days after the inspection out-brief

claim: Each FA in the FIR is marked Commendatory, Satisfactory or Unsatisfactory
quote: Effective ... Ineffective. Tier I (Commendatory) ... Tier II (Satisfactory) ... Tier III (Unsatisfactory) apply to commands
fix: State inspectors grade each FA Effective or Ineffective. Tier I, II and III are the overall command grade (90-100, 80-89, 0-79 percent of FAs effective).

claim: Commander signs an acknowledgement of FIR receipt that starts the CAR clock
quote: Within 30 calendar days after receiving the FIR
fix: Say the 30 days run from receiving the FIR. The order requires no acknowledgement.

claim: CIGs need not submit FIRs upward unless requested; Appendix C format may be modified
quote: Unless requested, CIGs are not required to submit FIRs to the IGMC, ACMC, CMC, Naval Inspector General (NAVIG), or SECNAV

claim: FIR recommendations supported by references
quote: Recommendations in the FIR must be supported by references

claim: Retention per DON schedules, chapter 6 section 3
quote: Inspection reports and other records will be retained in accordance with the appropriate DON records schedules

claim: NAVMC 10030 within 90 days of assuming command per MCBul 5210 dated 29 Aug 2025
quote: This Bulletin is cancelled one year from the date of publication or when incorporated into reference (d), whichever occurs first
fix: Note MCBul 5210 cancels on 29 August 2026. Cite the Marine Corps records management order that absorbs the NAVMC 10030 requirement, or confirm the Bulletin extension.

claim: SECNAV M-5210.1 and MCO 5210.11F govern retention
quote: a. IGMC Inspection Reports - Records Schedule 5000-14 b. CGIP Inspection Reports - Records Schedule 5000-69 c. Other Inspection Records - Records Schedule 1000-35
fix: Name the schedules: IGMC reports 5000-14, CGIP reports 5000-69, other inspection records 1000-35.

claim: Records-specific authority controls over MCO 5040.6K
quote: Records created as a result of this Order shall be managed according to NARA-approved dispositions
fix: Soften. The order defers to the DON schedules for disposition, it does not state a conflict rule.

claim: CoRE FAs inspected on an annual cycle, CoRE+ less often
quote: the IGMC Inspections Division inspects all major commands required to execute a CGIP for compliance with this Order every 36 months
fix: Replace the annual cadence with the 36 month CCI and ICI cycle for IGMC and the 36 month CGIP cycle for subordinate units. CoRE+ applies by capability, not by a lower frequency.

claim: IGMC cycle is annual
quote: every 36 months
fix: State the IGMC cycle is 36 months. IGMC publishes an annual schedule but inspects each command every 36 months.

claim: FACs published on the IGMC website are the ones inspectors use
quote: IGMC and CGIP inspectors shall use the most current FACs located on the IGMC website

claim: IGMC inspects against CoRE and CoRE+ FACs only
quote: The IGMC inspection team may inspect additional FAs at the IGMC discretion
fix: Add that IGMC may inspect additional non-CoRE FAs at its discretion.

claim: Pre-coordination with the supporting IG before an announced inspection
quote: Inspection agencies shall officially notify inspected units prior to the commencement of the inspection

claim: Do not use a FAC copy older than six months
quote: FACs that have not been updated within the previous 12 months will be removed from the IGMC website
fix: Say pull the current FAC from the IGMC website each time. Sponsors update FACs at least annually.

claim: Walk-through marks meets standard, partial, does not meet, not applicable
quote: Compliant ... Discrepancy ... Finding ... Not Applicable
fix: Use the order terms for FAC questions: Compliant, Discrepancy, Finding, Not Applicable.

claim: Self-audit severity tiers Critical, Significant, Minor
quote: Finding. A substantial problem, major deviation, or a systemic pattern of noncompliance from directives or standards
fix: Label the tiers a local aid. The order grades questions as Discrepancy or Finding and sets no correction timeline other than the 30 day CAR.

claim: Inspector sees the unit for two to four days
quote: n/a
fix: Drop the figure or mark it as typical practice.

claim: Portal tracks 32 programs across IGMC and MCAAT tracks
quote: Portal internal count
fix: Verify against the generated inspections catalog.

claim: FAC items are the floor, inspectors go beyond
quote: The IGMC inspection team may inspect additional FAs at the IGMC's discretion

claim: CoRE applies across O-5 and O-6 commands; below O-5 some FACs apply selectively
quote: inspect the CoRE/CoRE+ FAs (at a minimum) within all units led by general officers and board-selected commanders, regardless of unit size, mission, or location
fix: State CoRE and applicable CoRE+ FAs are inspected in every unit led by a general officer or board-selected commander regardless of size. Use the FAC applicability statement for FA-level scope.

claim: CoRE inspection coverage on an annual or near-annual cycle
quote: inspects independent commands to assess compliance of CoRE/CoRE+ FAs every 36 months
fix: Replace annual with every 36 months for IGMC CCIs and ICIs. IGMC publishes its schedule annually.

claim: CoRE+ is driven by higher headquarters emphasis, unit mission, trend findings and new policy
quote: The CoRE+ designation indicates CoRE FAs that are only applicable to commands possessing certain capabilities (e.g., aviation, law enforcement, etc.). Where applicable, CoRE+ FAs must be inspected
fix: Define CoRE+ as CoRE FAs that apply only to commands with certain capabilities, such as aviation or law enforcement. Remove HHQ emphasis, trend findings and new policy as CoRE+ drivers.

claim: CoRE+ becomes graded only once the supporting IG scopes it
quote: Where applicable, CoRE+ FAs must be inspected
fix: State CoRE+ FAs are mandatory wherever the capability applies. The IG announcement is not what makes them count.

claim: Walk CoRE+ FACs only when the IG announces scope
quote: CIGs shall inspect all CoRE/CoRE+ FAs
fix: Walk every applicable CoRE+ FAC on the same self-audit cycle as CoRE.

claim: FCP training under MARADMIN 490/26
quote: MARADMIN 468/26 is hereby canceled and is replaced with this MARADMIN

claim: CoRE FAC set published on the IGMC website, categories assigned by IGMC
quote: The IGMC is responsible for assigning FAs as CoRE, CoRE+, or non-CoRE ... published to the IGMC website

claim: List of typical CoRE functional areas (records, EO, SAPR, FPC, awards, OPSEC and others)
quote: The current list of FAs can be found at https://www.igmc.marines.mil/Divisions/Inspections-Division/Checklists
fix: Drop the typical lists or mark them as illustrative. The CoRE and CoRE+ list lives on the IGMC website and changes.

claim: Portal metadata mirrors FAC applicability
quote: Portal internal
fix: Verify against the generated inspections catalog.

claim: Chapter 2 establishes CoRE and CoRE+ FAs
quote: The IGMC is responsible for assigning FAs as CoRE, CoRE+, or non-CoRE

claim: Inspections row: stand the CGIP, 36 month cycle, sign CARs
quote: Commanders shall ensure their subordinate units are inspected at least every 36 months

claim: Waivers to IGMC with Appendix E template
quote: Requests for waivers to policies outlined in this Order must be submitted in writing to the IGMC per the example in Appendix E

claim: Publish unit METL in MCTIMS within 45 days of command
quote: Review, update, and publish the unit METL in MCTIMS annually, within 45 days of assuming command, or within 15 days of the assignment of a new mission

claim: Review CTR to eliminate late reports inside 30 days
quote: Fitness reports are due within 30 days of the end of the reporting period for normal reports or 60 days for adverse reports
fix: State fitness reports are due to HQMC within 30 days of the period end (60 days for adverse). The cached order does not use the term CTR.

claim: Chair Command Safety Council quarterly
quote: Command, unit and, activity safety councils will meet quarterly, or more often as directed by the chairperson

claim: 85 percent of on-hand personnel trained in MEO in the preceding year
quote: MCTIMS must demonstrate the command achieved at least 85% of on-hand personnel were trained in the preceding year

claim: CANX-014/26 cancelled MARADMIN 380/26
quote: cancelled

claim: Sign NAVMC 10030 within 90 days of command, appoint CDRM in CROSS
quote: This Bulletin is cancelled one year from the date of publication
fix: Confirm the 90 day NAVMC 10030 rule survives the 29 August 2026 MCBul cancellation. Cite the successor records order.

claim: Ensure PNOK notification within 8 hours of incident awareness
quote: The Marine Corps goal is to accomplish all required notifications within 8 hours of learning of the casualty incident. Hours of notification are 0500-2400
fix: State 8 hours is the goal, notification hours run 0500 to 2400 unless MFPC directs otherwise. MARADMIN 186/25 sets a 30 minute voice report and one hour template deadline for garrison casualties.

claim: Report questionable activities to IGMC within one business day
quote: Report immediately all questionable activities conducted by or on behalf of subordinate intelligence components to the IGMC
fix: Say report immediately. The cached order sets no one business day deadline.

claim: Meet monthly with SARC to review program status
quote: The victim immediate commander shall attend the monthly CMGs
fix: Cite the monthly Case Management Group requirement. A monthly commander-SARC meeting is not in the cached order.

claim: Process NAVMC 11296 personally
quote: NAVMC Form 11296, Marine Corps Request Mast Application

claim: Conduct commander verification on DD 2648
quote: Marines in possession of the DD Form 2648

claim: Retain CIRRAS appointment letters, monthly FPC
quote: The Command Individual Risk and Resiliency Assessment System (CIRRAS) is the Marine Corps identified electronic Program of Record force preservation tool

claim: Oversee 90 percent medical readiness
quote: MCWP 4-11.1 is not in the archive

claim: Aviation safety and operations rows (OPNAVINST 3750.6T, CNAF M-3710.7)
quote: Parent orders not in the cluster archive
fix: Verify against the parent orders.

claim: Oversee monthly random urinalysis and breathalyzer testing
quote: No match for monthly random testing in the cached order
fix: Verify the monthly random testing cadence against the current substance abuse order.

claim: Appoint Mail Officer and at least two Clerks in writing
quote: Unit Mail Clerks/Orderlies Qualification
fix: Verify the two-clerk minimum. The cached order covers clerk and orderly designation but states no two-clerk minimum.

claim: Pull the applicable FAC from this portal
quote: The IGMC website is the sole repository and official source for FACs. FACs posted on the IGMC website shall not be altered
fix: Pull the FAC from the IGMC website, the sole official source. Use the portal only as a cross-reference.

claim: Out-brief discrepancies trigger clarification before the 30 day FIR clock closes

claim: Evidence binders per FAC are an S-1 practice
quote: Inspection agencies shall officially notify inspected units prior to the commencement of the inspection

claim: Chapter 6 section 3 retention per DON schedules; MCO 5210.11F and SECNAV M-5210.1 set the schedules

quote: This Bulletin is cancelled one year from the date of publication or when incorporated into reference (d), whichever occurs first

quote: The IGMC website is the sole repository and official source for FACs

quote: The IGMC website is the sole repository and official source for FACs

quote: Compliant ... Discrepancy ... Finding ... Not Applicable (N/A)
